Airline Food.description: Found by breaking open regular and large luggages

Aloe Vera.description: Found in the mesa, using it will remove 50 heat

AMULET_CLONE.description: On use, duplicate an item. Duplicated items will have the same number of uses available as the original item. Amulets and checkpoint flags cannot be duplicated

AMULET_DOUBLEJUMP.description: On use, apply slow falling for .55 seconds and all scouts within 12.8 metres, then apply 3 seconds of wind walk (low gravity) for all affected scouts

AMULET_HEALING.description: On use, heals various negative status effects and applies invincibility for 10 seconds

AMULET_INFINITESTAM.description: On use, a yellow bubble is formed for 8 seconds around the player with a range of 9.6 metres, granting infinite stamina to the player and all scouts within the bubble

Ancient Idol.description: Found in Mesa's Tomb, holding it grants the player invincibility. Throwing it into the lava of the kiln destroys it and unlocks the 24 Karat Badge

anti-rope cannon.description: Attaches a 7.25 metre anti-rope which spools upwards. It has zero weight and will float when dropped

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Incinerating this item makes it unusable.
stateDescriptions.unusable: This item has been incinerated and can no longer be used.

anti-rope spool.description: Provides a total of 12.5 metres climbable anti gravity rope, placeable in custom lengths from 0.75m to 10m long. The rope will float upwards. It has negative weight and will float when dropped

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Incinerating this item makes it unusable.
stateDescriptions.unusable: This item has been incinerated and can no longer be used.

Antidote.description: Can be used up to 3 times. Cooking or throwing will cause it to shatter, removing up to 20 Poison and Spores from players within 4.8 metres depending on distance

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking shatters it; cooked use releases a small Poison-healing cloud without knockback.
stateDescriptions.burnt: Cooking shatters it; cooked use releases a small Poison-healing cloud without knockback.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Cooking shatters it; cooked use releases a small Poison-healing cloud without knockback.

Backpack.description: Occupies the player's fourth inventory slot and provides four additional storage slots

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking changes its appearance only; it can still hold items, even after repeated incineration.
stateDescriptions.burnt: Cooking changes its appearance only; it can still hold items, even after repeated incineration.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: It can still hold items after repeated incineration.

Balloon.description: On use, attaches a single ballon to the player. Dropping it causes it to fly away. Each attached ballon reduces gravity by 18%, with 6 or more granting an additional 100% reduction, causing them to fly upwards until popped (2 minutes or until the player ascends 160 metres)

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking pops the balloon.
stateDescriptions.unusable: The balloon has popped and can no longer be used.

Balloon Bunch.description: On use, attaches a bunch of balloons to the player, reducing gravity by 54% for 2 minutes or until 100 metres have been ascended. Dropping it causes it to fly away

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking pops the balloons.
stateDescriptions.unusable: The balloons have popped and can no longer be used.

Bandages.description: Single-use. Heals injury on the user

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.
stateDescriptions.burnt: Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.

Beehive.description: Found in trees in the tropics. Breaking it open drops four Honeycombs and releases the bees inside
Beehive.context: Found on trees in the Tropics; breaking it releases the bees and yields four Honeycombs.

stateDescriptions.cooked: The cooking stage transfers to the Honeycombs inside when the hive breaks.
stateDescriptions.burnt: The cooking stage transfers to the Honeycombs inside when the hive breaks.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: The cooking stage transfers to the Honeycombs inside when the hive breaks.

Berrynana Peel.description: Dropped after eating a Berrynana. Scouts who step on it will slip

Big Egg.description: Found in the caldera. Breaking it open yields an Egg, or rarely a pre-cooked Bird
Big Egg.context: Found in nests in the Caldera; cracking it yields an Egg or, sometimes, a Cooked Bird.

stateDescriptions.cooked: When cracked, its cooking stage transfers to the contents, except for a possible uncooked-bird result.
stateDescriptions.burnt: When cracked, its cooking stage transfers to the contents, except for a possible uncooked-bird result.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: When cracked, its cooking stage transfers to the contents, except for a possible uncooked-bird result.

Big Lollipop.description: Grants infinite stamina to the user while being eaten

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes the Drowsy penalty that follows its infinite-stamina effect.
Cooking lowers the pitch and volume of its voice lines.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: When incinerated, it stops playing voice lines.

Binoculars.description: Held to zoom in and view distant terrain

Bird.description: Found in the caldera, hatched from eggs. Spawns pre-cooked
Bird.context: A rare result from cracking Big Eggs or Small Eggs; it spawns pre-cooked.

stateDescriptions.cooked: It already spawns as Cooked; cooking it again makes it Well-Done, with the same effect as Cooked.
stateDescriptions.burnt: Burnt food restores less Hunger and no longer grants Extra Stamina.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Each further incineration adds Poison; the live modifier row shows the current effect.

Blowgun.description: Fires darts at other scouts. Does not spawn in solo play

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking changes its effect from Drowsy to Heat.
stateDescriptions.burnt: Its cooked effect applies Heat instead of Drowsy.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Its cooked effect applies Heat instead of Drowsy.

Blue Berrynana.description: Found in the tropics. Drops a Berrynana Peel when eaten

Blue Shroomberry.description: Found in the roots. Releases spores, and produces a harmful effect when eaten
Blue Shroomberry.context: Found in the Roots; releases Spores when eaten.

stateDescriptions.raw: Eating it can cause a random harmful effect.
stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes its Spores effect.

Bounce Fungus.description: Found in the roots. Creates a bouncy platform when thrown at a surface

Brown Berrynana.description: Found in the tropics. Drops a Berrynana Peel when eaten

Bugle.description: Found at the photobooth and crash site. Plays a musical note when used
Bugle.context: Plays a musical note when used.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Each cooking makes its pitch wobble more.
stateDescriptions.burnt: Each cooking makes its pitch wobble more.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Each cooking makes its pitch wobble more.

Bugle of Friendship.description: While played, grants all scouts in a large radius infinite stamina, up to a total of 7.5 seconds

Bugle Shroom.description: Found on the shore, tropics and mesa. Some variants afflict poison after 10 seconds
Bugle Shroom.context: Found in the Shore, Tropics, Roots, and Mesa; some varieties are poisonous.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking does not remove Poison from poisonous mushroom varieties.

Button Shroom.description: Found on the shore, tropics and mesa. Some variants afflict poison after 10 seconds
Button Shroom.context: Found in the Shore, Tropics, Roots, and Mesa; some varieties are poisonous.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking does not remove Poison from poisonous mushroom varieties.

Cactus.description: Found in the mesa. Afflicts thorns onto the user

Candlestick.description: Found in the gloom and the Citadel. Provides a source of light

Chain Launcher.description: Creates a climbable chain between two points
Chain Launcher.context: Creates a climbable chain between two points.

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Incinerating this item makes it unusable.
stateDescriptions.unusable: This item has been incinerated and can no longer be used.

Checkpoint Flag.description: Places a single-use respawn checkpoint for the scout who placed it
Checkpoint Flag.context: Places a single-use respawn checkpoint for the Scout who placed it.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Only explosives can cook this flag, and each explosion advances its cooking stage by two. Cooking adds a Bonus stamina effect when it is used.

Chubby Shroom.description: Found on the shore, tropics and roots

Cloud Fungus.description: Found in the roots. Creates a platform when thrown at a wall

Cluster Shroom.description: Found on the shore, tropics and mesa. Some variants afflict poison after 10 seconds
Cluster Shroom.context: Found in the Shore, Tropics, Roots, and Mesa; some varieties are poisonous.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking does not remove Poison from poisonous mushroom varieties.

Coconut.description: Found on the shore, tropics and mesa. Breaking it yields two Coconut Halves
Coconut.context: Found in the Shore, Tropics, and Mesa; breaking it produces two Half-Coconuts.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking it produces cooked Half-Coconuts.

Coconut Half.context: Made by splitting a Coconut; eating a half also removes Heat.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking once doubles its Hunger restoration and adds Bonus stamina; the current amounts remain in the live modifier row.

Compass.description: Found at the shore crash site. Points towards the PEAK

Conch.description: Found on the shore. Can be thrown, but serves little other purpose

Cure-All.description: On use, removes nearly every negative status effect from the user

stateDescriptions.cooked: When used after cooking, it explodes into a small healing cloud without knockback.
stateDescriptions.burnt: When used after cooking, it explodes into a small healing cloud without knockback.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: When used after cooking, it explodes into a small healing cloud without knockback.

Cursed Skull.description: On use, instantly kills the scout holding it and grants bonus stamina to other players

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking activates it immediately, then triggers a dynamite-like explosion.

Dynamite.description: Found on the ground and in luggage in the mesa. Detonates after a short fuse, afflicting injury to nearby scouts

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking makes it explode immediately.

EARLYWORM.description: Found in the gloom. Removes drowsiness from the user
EARLYWORM.context: Found moving on the ground in the Gloom; eating it clears Drowsy and grants the Well Rested badge.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking stops the worm moving but adds no Bonus stamina.
stateDescriptions.burnt: The worm remains stopped; Burnt food restores less Hunger and grants no Bonus stamina.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Each further incineration adds Poison when eaten; the live modifier row shows the current effect.

Egg.description: Found in the caldera and gloom, or produced by breaking a Big Egg

Energy Drink.description: Grants a temporary speed boost and afflicts drowsiness

stateDescriptions.cooked: When consumed, a cooked drink explodes and knocks back nearby players; its speed effect lasts 4 seconds longer and adds no new Drowsy afterward.

Faerie Lantern.description: Removes several negative status effects from the user over 30 seconds

stateDescriptions.cooked: When used after cooking, it explodes into a small healing cloud.
stateDescriptions.burnt: When used after cooking, it explodes into a small healing cloud.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: When used after cooking, it explodes into a small healing cloud.

Fannypack.description: Worn to provide additional storage slots

First Aid Kit.description: Takes 5 seconds to use. Removes poison and spores, and heals injury
First Aid Kit.context: Removes Poison and Spores and heals Injury.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.
stateDescriptions.burnt: Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Cooking changes its appearance only; its use effect is unchanged.

Flare.description: Found at the crash site and peak. Summons the rescue helicopter when used at the PEAK
Flare.context: Summons the rescue helicopter when used at the Peak.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking makes it explode, injuring scouts in a small radius.
The first cooking stage adds 10 seconds of invulnerability; further cooking adds no more time.

Frisbee.description: Thrown through the air, and can bonk other scouts

Frog.description: Found in the gloom. Can be picked up and carried

Glider.description: Held while falling to glide slowly and steer through the air

Gold Prickleberry.description: Found in the mesa. Removes heat and heals injury, but afflicts thorns

Green Crispberry.description: Found on bushes on the Shore and in the Tropics; it also appears at a few special locations in other biomes.
Green Crispberry.context: Found on bushes, mainly in the Shore and Tropics, with occasional plants elsewhere.

stateDescriptions.raw: Eating it inflicts Poison after 2 seconds, lasting 4 seconds.
stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes its Poison effect; Cooked and Well-Done do not stack.
stateDescriptions.burnt: Burnt food restores less Hunger and no longer grants Bonus Stamina.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Each further incineration adds Poison.

Green Kingberry.description: Found in the tropics. Afflicts poison onto the user
Green Kingberry.context: Found on trees in the Tropics.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes its Poison effect.

Green Shroomberry.description: Found in the roots. Releases spores, and produces a harmful effect when eaten
Green Shroomberry.context: Found in the Roots; releases Spores when eaten.

stateDescriptions.raw: Eating it can cause a random harmful effect.
stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes its Spores effect.

Guidebook.description: Found at the shore crash site. Teaches basic gameplay

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Incinerating this item makes it unusable.
stateDescriptions.unusable: This item has been incinerated and can no longer be used.

Heat Pack.description: Found in the alpine. Removes cold from the user

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking makes it explode, injuring scouts in a small radius.

Honeycomb.description: Obtained by breaking a Beehive in the tropics and roots

Jetpack.description: Worn to propel the scout upwards while its fuel lasts

Lantern.description: Found in the tropics and alpine. Provides light and removes cold

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking makes it explode, injuring scouts in a small radius.

Magic Bean.description: Grows a climbable vine up to 10 metres tall roughly 3 seconds after being planted, if unobstructed

Mandrake.description: Found in the roots. Screams when uprooted. Eaten raw, it hides the stamina bar for 60 seconds
Mandrake.context: Found in the Roots; it screams after being uprooted.

stateDescriptions.raw: Eating it raw hides the Stamina bar for 60 seconds.
stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking stops its scream; eating it cooked removes Curse.

Marshmallow.description: Found throughout the climb. Can be roasted over a fire

Medicinal Root.description: Found on the shore, tropics, roots and mesa. Removes poison and spores, and heals injury
Medicinal Root.context: Found in the Shore, Tropics, Roots, and Mesa.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes additional Poison and Spores.

Megaphone.description: Amplifies the scout's voice over a long distance

Napberry.description: Found in the alpine. Afflicts drowsiness, and removes all status effects except curse

Orange Winterberry.description: Found in the alpine. Removes heat from the user

Pandora's Lunchbox.description: Can be used 3 times. Each use randomizes the user's status effects

stateDescriptions.cooked: When cooked, it explodes and applies its random effects to nearby players without knockback.
stateDescriptions.burnt: When cooked, it explodes and applies its random effects to nearby players without knockback.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: When cooked, it explodes and applies its random effects to nearby players without knockback.

Parasol.description: Protects the scout from the mesa's sunlight, and slows a fall when held

Pink Berrynana.description: Found in the tropics. Drops a Berrynana Peel when eaten
Pink Berrynana.context: Found on vines in the Tropics; eating it produces a peel.

stateDescriptions.raw: Eating it inflicts Poison after a 2-second delay, over 6 seconds.
stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes its Poison effect.

Pirate's Compass.description: Points to the nearest unopened luggage or unused Ancient Statue

Piton.description: Attaches to a climbable surface, providing a point for scouts to grab and rest
Piton.context: Attaches to climbable surfaces as a point to grab and rest.

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Incinerating this item makes it unusable.
stateDescriptions.unusable: This item has been incinerated and can no longer be used.

Portable Stove.description: Placed to cook items. Lasts 60 seconds after being placed
Portable Stove.context: Can be placed to cook items.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking makes it explode, injuring scouts in a small radius.

Purple Shroomberry.description: Found in the roots. Releases spores, and produces a random good or bad effect when eaten
Purple Shroomberry.context: Found in the Roots; releases Spores when eaten.

stateDescriptions.raw: Eating it can cause a random good or bad effect.
stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes its Spores effect.

Red Clusterberry.description: Found in the tropics. Heals injury on the user

Red Prickleberry.description: Found in the mesa. Removes heat, but afflicts thorns
Red Prickleberry.context: Found on cacti in the Mesa.

stateDescriptions.raw: Eating it attaches Thorns to the Scout.
stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes the attached Thorns.

Red Shroomberry.description: Found in the roots. Releases spores, and produces a beneficial effect when eaten
Red Shroomberry.context: Found in the Roots; releases Spores when eaten.

stateDescriptions.raw: Eating it can cause a random beneficial effect.
stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking removes its Spores effect.

Remedy Fungus.description: Releases a cloud of healing smoke with an 8 metre radius when dropped

Rescue Claw.description: Can be used 3 times. Pulls the wielder toward terrain, or pulls other scouts toward them
Rescue Claw.context: Pulls the wielder toward terrain or pulls other scouts toward them.

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Incinerating this item makes it unusable.
stateDescriptions.unusable: This item has been incinerated and can no longer be used.

RitualDagger.description: Found in ancient luggage and statues. On use, removes the user's negative status effects

Rocketpack.description: Worn to launch the scout upwards in a single burst

rope cannon.description: Fires a harpoon that drops a climbable rope where it strikes a compatible surface
rope cannon.context: Fires a harpoon that drops a climbable rope where it strikes a compatible surface.

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Incinerating this item makes it unusable.
stateDescriptions.unusable: This item has been incinerated and can no longer be used.

rope spool.description: Deploys climbable rope up to 10 metres long, attachable to any climbable surface
rope spool.context: Deploys climbable rope up to 10 metres long.

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Incinerating this item makes it unusable.
stateDescriptions.unusable: This item has been incinerated and can no longer be used.

Scorchberry.description: Found in the tropics, roots and alpine. Afflicts heat onto the user

Scorpion.description: Found in the mesa. Can be held but not stored in an inventory slot, and cannot be eaten raw
Scorpion.context: Found in Mesa canyons and cliffs; it can be held but not stored, and it cannot be eaten raw.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking makes it edible and stops it moving or attacking; it still cannot be stored in an inventory slot or Backpack.

Scout Cannon.description: Places a cannon that launches scouts across the map. Afflicts injury on launch

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking makes it explode in a manner similar to Dynamite.

Scout Effigy.description: Resurrects a dead scout at a target location. Does not spawn in solo play
Scout Effigy.context: A one-use mystical item that can revive a dead or unconscious Scout at the target location; it does not spawn in solo play.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking grants Bonus stamina when the effigy is used.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: Using it after Incineration also inflicts Poison on the user.

Scoutmaster's Bugle.description: Grants the user and nearby scouts bonus stamina, and summons the Scoutmaster for two minutes
Scoutmaster's Bugle.context: A one-use mystical item from Ancient Luggage or an Ancient Statue; playing it grants nearby Scouts Bonus stamina and summons the Scoutmaster.

stateDescriptions.incinerated: Playing it after Incineration also inflicts Poison on the user.

SCOUTMASTERSOUL.description: Freed from a bubble in Nadir. Carrying it to the PEAK restores the Scoutmaster and unlocks the secret ending

ScoutsHonor.description: Held by the Stone Scout at the PEAK. On use, transports all players to Nadir
ScoutsHonor.context: Created when four Scout Amulets are bestowed on the Stone Scout at the Peak; activating it sends all Scouts to Nadir.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking triggers a 40-meter Anti-Sphere explosion and summons the Scoutmaster to chase the player who cooked it.

Scroll.description: Found at campfires. Opens to reveal a Torn Page
Scroll.context: Found at campfires; opening it reveals a Torn Page.

stateDescriptions.cooked: Cooking adds a Bonus stamina effect when the scroll is opened.

Shelf Fungus.description: Creates a platform when thrown at a wall

SNOWBALL.description: Found in the alpine. Can be thrown at other scouts
SNOWBALL.context: Collected from snow piles; larger snowballs hit harder and eventually become too large to pick up.

stateDescriptions.cooked: A cooked Snowball inflicts Cold when it hits but does not knock the target down.

Sports Drink.description: Removes a large amount of heat from the user

stateDescriptions.cooked: The first cooking stage adds Bonus Stamina; further cooking has no effect.
stateDescriptions.burnt: This drink has no Burnt-stage penalty.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: This drink has no Incinerated-stage penalty.

Stick.description: Can be thrown or used as fuel for a fire

Stone.description: Can be picked up and thrown

Strange Gem.description: Held by the Stone Scout at the PEAK. Can be toggled on and off, but serves no practical purpose
Strange Gem.context: Found in the Stone Scout’s hands at the Peak; clicking it toggles its activation message.

stateDescriptions.cooked: If bestowed on the Stone Scout, it grants Bonus stamina to the user.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: If bestowed after Incineration, it also inflicts Poison on the user.

Sunscreen.description: Can be used 3 times. Each spray grants sun protection for 90 seconds

stateDescriptions.cooked: When used after cooking, it explodes into a large sunscreen cloud without knockback.
stateDescriptions.burnt: When used after cooking, it explodes into a large sunscreen cloud without knockback.
stateDescriptions.incinerated: When used after cooking, it explodes into a large sunscreen cloud without knockback.

Tick.description: Found in the tropics. Does not afflict poison when eaten

Torch.description: Found only inside the mesa's Tomb. Provides light for a limited time

VOIDLAUNCHER.context: Shoots an Anti-Sphere that reverses gravity where it lands.

Warp Compass.description: Teleports the user to a random scout. No longer obtainable in normal play after bugs sent players off the map

Warp Fungus.description: When thrown, teleports the user to where it lands
